reader.requirement: At --std 85, in random access (and the random statements of dynamic access), the value of the RELATIVE KEY item at the start of the statement selects the record a READ, WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE acts on; a number with no record gives 23, an occupied number on WRITE gives 22, and a key below 1 on WRITE is the 1985 boundary condition 24.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError (2014): key below 1 gives invalid key 24 at 85, permanent error 34 at 2023

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: a random WRITE with a key of 0 runs the INVALID KEY phrase with status 24 at 85 (the 1985 status list has no 34); from 2014 it is the permanent error 34.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c12_access_mode_random_dynamic and g85_f17_04 cover READ of a present and an absent number and WRITE of an occupied one; not key 0, the largest key, a COMP key, DELETE by key, or a READ INTO that overwrites the key (probed here).

probes.printed: RDY KEY 0 INV 23 / RDY KEY 998 INV 23 / RDY KEY 7 DELETED INV 23 / DEL7 00 / DEL7 AGAIN INV 23 / RC KEY 10 00 [0010  ] / RC INTO KEY 00 KC=14649 [999LLL]
probes.expected: the key value selects the record; absent, zero or deleted numbers give 23; with READ RC INTO KC the record at RRN 999 (the key's value before the statement) is read

probes.printed: COBOL0863 for a signed key (S99), a key with P (9P) and a key in the file's own record
KC PIC 9(4) COMP as RELATIVE KEY: RC KEY 10 00 [0010  ]
probes.expected: any unsigned integer item is a relative key

reader.notes: KC=14649 is the alphanumeric-to-numeric INTO move of '999LLL' (content undefined), not a key effect; the selected record shows the key was read before the move. The edition arm for key 0 on WRITE takes the 1985 status.

refuter.evidence: Operand classes of the key (§1985:VIII.2.4.3 SR2) the reader did not try (runs r43*-001, --std 85): PIC 9V9, PIC XX, PIC Z9, a group, and USAGE INDEX each refused COBOL0863 (an index data item may be referenced only in SEARCH, SET, a relation condition or USING, §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5, so it is not a relative key); a qualified key 'K OF G' (SR1) and an EXTERNAL PIC 9(3) key admitted. r44-001: qualified PIC 9(3) COMP key, WRITE at 4 and at 999 (the largest 3-digit key) 00; random REWRITE of absent 5 -> 23; REWRITE of 4 -> 00 and READ 4 gives CCCC; DELETE and REWRITE with key 0 -> 23; READ 999 gives ZZZZ.
